evidence_basis: Only the MCT8-deficiency management section and the Triac recommendations of the 2024 European Thyroid Association guideline were read; this is a guideline (secondary synthesis), not a primary trial.

Locator L1 (Management and treatment; for: Levothyroxine did not improve neurodevelopment in MCT8 deficiency): "Treatment with levothyroxine in a wide dose range (2.5–15 mcg/kg/day), commenced at the age of 0.5 to 36 months, did not improve neurodevelopment and, in some cases even aggravated the hyperthyroid state in peripheral tissues"

Locator L2 (Management and treatment; for: Neurological efficacy of Triac unknown at the guideline date): "The neurocognitive response to TRIAC treatment is unknown (123, 124), and is currently under investigation (NCT02396459)."
Locator L3 (Management and treatment; for: No proven neurocognitive rescue): "No available treatment regimen has proven to rescue the neurocognitive phenotype in humans with MCT8 deficiency."
Locator L4 (Management and treatment; for: Triac paediatric dose range): "TRIAC therapy (dose range: 6.4–84.3 mcg/kg/day) has proven to have beneficial effects for some features:"
Locator L5 (Areas of uncertainty; for: Open safety question: T4 lowering): "Potential adverse effects of further lowering (F)T4 concentrations with TRIAC treatment."
